extraction_notes: Only the main article text and page images were supplied; Supporting Information tables/figures cited by the paper were not available for extraction. Figure 1a contains trend plots for several CZ-x catalysts over 220–260 °C, but individual temperature assignments/values are not printed on the plot; to avoid unreliable estimates, only the CZ-23 260 °C values explicitly printed in text were extracted. Figure 1c time-on-stream points are dense and not numerically labeled, so individual TOS records were not extracted. Figure 4d/related plots compare etched catalysts but the plotted performance values are small/dense and not printed; they were not extracted. Literature-comparison data in Scheme 1/Figure 1d were excluded.
